items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: he and him would get them little old jobs, and people would go for us playing, no style, the boogers would go, and he could play, he'd teach me a lot of chords, you know.

ctx.x: And so, and, and, you know, but I was coming in and he made me mad. He told me he had some whiskey, Sturdy was really alcohol, like to drink whiskey. He burnt some alcohol and messed it up, that something, and gave it to him some water, coke or something, I don't know how to, made him sick and made him foam at the mouth. We got, we got, we got, I got Miss Vison to get a doctor there, 20, 30, and pop them. And she got him, we got him straight, but he didn't, he didn't come two times away, so. See, Sturdy was a…
You've got to be a man.
